test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir (As of April 2024)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manoj Sinha** was **appointed L.G. of Jammu & Kashmir** in **Aug 2020**, succeeding **Girish Chandra Murmu**.
 
• He oversees **development**, **security, and governance**.
 
• **Sinha** prioritizes **peace and economic growth** during his tenure.
 
• Prioritized development, **peace-building**, and s**ecurity measures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satya Pal Malik**

 
 
• Served as **Governor** of J**ammu and Kashmir** from **August 2018 to October 2019**.
 
• Emphasized governance, **security, and development **in **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
 
 
• **Girish Chandra Murmu**
 
 
• Served as the **first Lieutenant Governor **of **Jammu and Kashmir** from **October 31, 2019, to August 6, 2020**.
 
• Later appointed as the **Comptroller and Auditor General** (CAG) **of India**.
 
 
 
• **NN Vohra**
 
 
• **Narinder Nath Vohra** served as the **Governor of Jammu and Kashmir** from **2008 to 2018**.
 
• He is a **retired Indian Administrative Service** (IAS) officer of the **1959 batch **from the **Punjab cadre**.
